es: Redactar avisos y consejos de seguridad con unless, provided that / as long as, in case y had better, usando presente tras la conjunción y verbo base tras had better.

teaching.en: Do not start the climb unless the weather is clear.
teaching.es: No empieces la subida a menos que el tiempo esté despejado.
teaching.explanationEs: Unless ya significa «si no»: no se le añade otra negación.
teaching.audioText: Do not start the climb unless the weather is clear.

teaching.en: You may camp here provided that you leave no rubbish.
teaching.es: Puedes acampar aquí siempre que no dejes basura.
teaching.explanationEs: Provided that / as long as + presente: condición necesaria; no se usa will detrás.
teaching.audioText: You may camp here provided that you leave no rubbish.

teaching.en: Take a torch in case the path is dark.
teaching.es: Lleva una linterna por si el camino está oscuro.
teaching.explanationEs: In case + presente: te preparas antes de que pase; no equivale a if.
teaching.audioText: Take a torch in case the path is dark.

teaching.en: You had better turn back if the route is icy.
teaching.es: Más vale que des la vuelta si la ruta está helada.
teaching.explanationEs: Had better + verbo base, sin to: consejo fuerte con una consecuencia implícita.
teaching.audioText: You had better turn back if the route is icy.

teaching.en: You will be fine as long as you carry a waterproof jacket.
teaching.es: Estarás bien siempre que lleves una chaqueta impermeable.
teaching.explanationEs: As long as equivale a provided that en el habla diaria; condición necesaria.
segments: You will be fine as long
as you carry a waterproof jacket.
teaching.audioText: You will be fine as long as you carry a waterproof jacket.

teaching.en: It is sensible to rest in the shelter if the storm arrives.
teaching.es: Es sensato descansar en el refugio si llega la tormenta.
teaching.explanationEs: It is sensible to + verbo: un consejo razonable, más suave que had better.
segments: It is sensible to rest in
the shelter if the storm arrives.
teaching.audioText: It is sensible to rest in the shelter if the storm arrives.

prompt.es: Elige el aviso que solo permite subir con buena visibilidad.

choices.text: Don't climb unless the visibility isn't good.
Don't climb provided that the visibility is bad.
Don't climb unless the visibility is good.

feedback.es: Unless equivale a «si no» y lleva la condición en positivo; con otra negación el aviso se contradice.

hint.es: Unless ya significa «si no»: no añadas otra negación.

prompt.es: Completa: «Puedes entrar siempre que lleves casco.»

feedback.es: Provided that y as long as expresan la condición necesaria, «siempre que»; detrás va el presente.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué debe hacer quien encienda un fuego.

choices.text: Use a metal ring and keep water close.
Ask the guard before lighting it.
Never light a fire on the campsite.

feedback.es: El aviso permite el fuego si se usan los aros de metal y pide tener agua cerca por si sube el viento.

origin.audio: Welcome to the campsite. You can light a fire provided that you use the metal rings, and please keep a bottle of water nearby in case the wind rises.

prompt.es: Completa: «Más vale que lleves un abrigo; hará frío.»

feedback.es: Had better + verbo base da un consejo fuerte y el adjetivo better es parte fija de la estructura.

prompt.es: Elige el aviso que refleja la regla de la playa.

choices.text: Don't swim unless the red flag isn't down.
Don't swim unless the red flag is down.
Swim in case the red flag is down.

feedback.es: La regla admite nadar solo si la bandera roja está abajo; unless la expresa sin negación adicional.

origin.text: Beach rule: no swimming, except when the red flag is down.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué debe hacer la persona para conservar su cama.

choices.text: Book one week before by post.
Arrive before six and phone the cabin.

feedback.es: El aviso exige llegar antes de las seis y llamar; si no llama, la cabaña puede dar la cama a otra persona.

origin.audio: You had better book the mountain cabin today. Provided that you arrive before six, they will keep your bed, but unless you phone, they may give it to someone else.

prompt.es: Completa: «Lleva una chaqueta impermeable por si llueve.»

feedback.es: In case + presente expresa prevención: llevas la chaqueta antes de que llueva.

origin.text: Take a waterproof jacket ___ it rains.

prompt.es: Escribe seis avisos de seguridad para una ruta de montaña.

answer.text: 1. Do not start the climb unless the sky is clear at seven in the morning. 2. You may walk along the ridge provided that the wind is light. 3. Take a torch in case you come down after dark. 4. You had better turn back if the rocks are icy, because a fall is a real danger. 5. Stay on the marked route as long as the fog is thick. 6. Carry some water in case the afternoon is hot.
accepted: 1. Do not start the climb unless the sky is clear at seven in the morning. 2. You may walk along the ridge provided that the wind is light. 3. Take a torch in case you come down after dark. 4. You had better turn back if the rocks are icy, because a fall is a real danger. 5. Stay on the marked route as long as the fog is thick. 6. Carry some water in case the afternoon is hot.

Notice 1: Nobody should go up unless a guide has checked the path. Notice 2: The shelter is open provided that you leave it clean. Notice 3: Bring a warm coat in case the night is cold. Notice 4: You had better start early if you want to reach the summit. Notice 5: It is safe to cross the bridge as long as it is dry. Notice 6: Keep your phone charged in case you need help.

feedback.es: Un buen aviso une una instrucción con una condición en presente: unless para excepciones, provided that o as long as para condiciones, in case para prevenir y had better para aconsejar con fuerza.

origin.text: Eres guía en un sendero de montaña que sube por un bosque y termina en una cresta. Escribe seis avisos breves (entre 65 y 130 palabras en total). Usa unless, provided that o as long as, in case y had better, y nombra en cada aviso un peligro o una medida concreta.

prompt.es: Elige el consejo fuerte que advierte de una consecuencia.

choices.text: You had better walk; the road is icy.
You had better to walk; the road is icy.
You have better walk; the road is icy.

feedback.es: Had better se escribe con had y va seguido del verbo base sin to; las otras opciones cambian la forma.

origin.text: A friend plans to cycle to work, but the road is covered in ice. You want to give strong advice.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuándo es gratis el museo.

choices.text: When the visitor books in advance.

feedback.es: El museo es gratis los domingos solo si se reserva; as long as marca esa condición necesaria.

origin.audio: The museum is free on Sundays as long as you book online. In case the website is down, you can phone the office, but unless you book, you will have to pay.

prompt.es: Escribe el aviso de prohibición del fuego con excepción.

answer.text: Do not light a fire unless a guard is present.
accepted: Do not light a fire unless a guard is present.
Nobody may light a fire unless a guard is there.
Don't light a fire unless a guard is present.

feedback.es: Unless introduce la excepción en positivo: solo se puede encender fuego si hay un guardia presente.

origin.text: Escribe un aviso para un parque: nadie puede encender fuego a menos que haya un guardia presente.
